{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Silk blouse with a slightly relaxed fit, knee-length, color midnight blue with hex code #191970, soft woven fabric.
High-waisted tailored trousers in wide-leg cut, full length, color charcoal grey with hex code #36454F, heavy wool blend fabric.
Structured blazer in single-breasted style, hip length, color black with hex code #000000, matte cotton gabardine fabric.
Heeled pumps with a stiletto shape, ankle height, color gold with hex code #FFD700, polished leather material.
Gold statement necklace and matching drop earrings to add warmth against the dark ensemble.
This outfit strikes the perfect balance for an evening date at 19:30 in autumn by combining sophisticated tailoring with a touch of sparkle. The navy blouse offers a modern contrast to the classic black blazer, while the wide-leg trousers provide comfortable elegance suitable for walking between restaurant seating areas. A whisper of artificial light catches on the gold accessories and metallic heels, ensuring you look polished and radiant under evening dining lights without feeling overdressed for the occasion."}
